html_title: StreetZim — Mapu a Kiwix ogwira ntchito popanda intaneti
meta_description: Mapu aulere a OpenStreetMap, ogwira ntchito kwathunthu popanda intaneti, opangidwira Kiwix. Matailosi a vector, zithunzi za setilaiti, nthaka ya 3D ndi zambiri za Wikipedia — amagwira ntchito popanda intaneti pa iOS, Android, Mac, Windows ndi Linux.
tagline: Mapu a OpenStreetMap ogwira ntchito kwathunthu popanda intaneti, opangidwira Kiwix. Matailosi a vector, zithunzi za setilaiti, nthaka ya 3D ndi Wikipedia — intaneti siyofunika.
maps_intro: Sankhani dera pansipa, ikani Kiwix, kenako tsegulani fayilo ya .zim. Mafayilo amasungidwa pa Internet Archive — fayilo iliyonse ilinso ndi torrent.
maps_intro_lang: Sankhani dera pansipa ndipo litsitseni m'Chichewa: mayina a pa mapu, kusaka ndi Wikipedia zili m'Chichewa. Tsegulani fayiloyo mu Kiwix, pulogalamu yaulere; tsamba la mapu aliwonse limasonyeza mmene mungachitire, sitepe ndi sitepe.
feature_key_intro: Mabaji a pa khadi lililonse amasonyeza zomwe zili mkati:
badge_nav_desc: kutsogoleredwa kokhota ndi kokhota popanda intaneti,
badge_overture_desc: mawebusayiti, manambala a foni ndi malo ochezera ochokera ku Overture,
badge_terrain_desc: kukwera kwa nthaka kochokera ku Copernicus,
badge_photo_desc: pezani malo pogwiritsa ntchito chithunzi cha chikwangwani.
what_lead: StreetZim imaika deta ya OpenStreetMap — mayiko athunthu kapena makontinenti — mu fayilo imodzi ya ZIM yomwe mungatsegule mu Kiwix. Imagwira ntchito kwathunthu popanda intaneti: palibe maseva, palibe zopempha za API, ndipo intaneti siyofunika mukamaliza kutsitsa.
what_p2: Mosiyana ndi mapulogalamu a mapu wamba omwe amagwiritsa ntchito matailosi a raster, StreetZim imagwiritsa ntchito matailosi a vector ojambulidwa pa chipangizo chanu ndi MapLibre GL JS. Zotsatira zake: kusuntha, kukulitsa ndi kuzunguliza mapu bwinobwino, ngakhale nthaka ya 3D — zonse kuchokera mu fayilo imodzi pa chipangizo chanu.
feat_vector_p: Mapu omveka bwino ndi osalala mpaka pa misewu, ogwiritsa ntchito dongosolo la OpenMapTiles, ojambulidwa nthawi yomweyo ndi MapLibre.
feat_sat_p: Zithunzi za Sentinel-2 zopanda mitambo, zatsatanetsatane wa mamita 10, za dera lonse la pa mapu.
feat_terrain_p: Mithunzi ya mapiri ndi kukwera kwa nthaka mu 3D kuchokera ku Copernicus GLO-30, chitsanzo cha kukwera kwa nthaka cha dziko lonse.
feat_wiki_p: Dinani mzinda uliwonse, phiri kapena malo odziwika kuti muone nkhani yake ya Wikipedia ndi mfundo zake zazikulu.
feat_search_p: Sakani m'mamiliyoni a mayina a malo, misewu, mapaki, nsonga za mapiri, mabwalo a ndege ndi malo osangalatsa.
feat_offline_p: Fayilo imodzi yokha ya .zim. Palibe maakaunti, palibe kusonkhanitsa deta, palibe netiweki. Tsegulani ndi kuyamba.
step1_p: Pulogalamu yaulere yowerengera ya iOS, Android, Mac, Windows ndi Linux. Ipezeni pa kiwix.org. Pa Windows ndi Linux, pakadali pano tsegulani mapu mu Kiwix PWA: Kiwix Desktop 2.5 imawasonyeza opanda kanthu, ndipo kukonza kwake kukupezeka m'mitundu ya tsiku ndi tsiku (nightly) yokha.
step2_p: Sankhani dera pamwambapa ndipo tsitsani fayilo ya .zim (kapena gwiritsani ntchito torrent kuti zifulumire).
step2_p_lang: Sankhani dera pamwambapa ndipo dinani batani lake lotsitsa: mumalandira mapu m'Chichewa, ngati fayilo imodzi ya .zim.
step3_p: Tsegulani fayilo ya .zim mu pulogalamu ya Kiwix. Basi — mapu amagwira ntchito kwathunthu popanda intaneti.
sources_intro: StreetZim yapangidwa kwathunthu ndi deta yotseguka. ZIM ya mapu aliwonse ili ndi zinthu zochokera ku magwero awa:
src_map: Deta ya mapu: © Othandizira a OpenStreetMap, ikupezeka pansi pa Open Database License (ODbL).
src_sat: Zithunzi za setilaiti: EOxCloudless https://cloudless.eox.at by EOX IT Services GmbH (Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2021) — CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, pa ntchito zosakhala zamalonda zokha.
src_elev: Kukwera kwa nthaka: Copernicus GLO-30 DEM — © DLR / Airbus, yoperekedwa pansi pa pulogalamu ya COPERNICUS ndi European Union ndi ESA.
src_place: Zambiri za malo: Wikidata (CC0) ndi Wikipedia (CC BY-SA 4.0).
src_code: Khodi ya chida: StreetZim — MIT License.
oss_intro: StreetZim imadalira mapulogalamu owerengera a Kiwix kuti itsegule mafayilo a .zim. Pulogalamu iliyonse ndi ya open source ndipo imapangidwa pa GitHub:
footer: StreetZim ndi pulojekiti ya open source. Khodi ili pa GitHub. Mapu amasungidwa pa Internet Archive.
tier_continent: Makontinenti ndi madera aakulu ngati kontinenti
card_preview_title: Onani mapu awa mu msakatuli wanu, akuchokera ku archive.org
card_languages_title: Mapu awa ali ndi mayina ake ndi Wikipedia m'chilankhulo china, osonkhanitsidwa mu msakatuli wanu
card_download_lang_title: Mapu awa ali ndi mayina ake, kusaka ndi Wikipedia m'Chichewa, ngati fayilo imodzi ya .zim
card_original_title: Mapu monga anapangidwira: mayina a malo m'chilankhulo cha kumaloko; zolembedwa za pulogalamu ndi Wikipedia m'Chingerezi
card_no_lang: Sanapezekebe m'Chichewa: mapu awa ali ndi mayina a malo m'chilankhulo cha kumaloko ndipo zolembedwa za pulogalamu zili m'Chingerezi.

mp_feat_nav: Njira zoyenda wapansi, pa njinga ndi pa galimoto, zowerengedwa pa chipangizo chanu.
mp_feat_overture: Masitolo, malesitilanti ndi malo ena, pamodzi ndi mawebusayiti ndi manambala awo a foni.
mp_feat_satellite: Zithunzi za setilaiti za dera lonse.
mp_feat_wiki: Nkhani za Wikipedia za mizinda, malo odziwika ndi malo okaona.
mp_feat_photo: Sakani ndi chithunzi: jambulani chikwangwani kuti mupeze malowo pa mapu.

mp_dl_original_note: Mapu monga anapangidwira: mayina a malo m'chilankhulo cha kumaloko; zolembedwa za pulogalamu ndi Wikipedia m'Chingerezi.
mp_dl_preview: Yambani mwaona mapu mu msakatuli wanu
mp_space_note: Musanatsitse, onetsetsani kuti chipangizo chanu chili ndi malo okwanira. Mapu aakulu amatsitsidwa bwino pa Wi-Fi.

kg_android_1: Ikani Kiwix kuchokera ku Google Play. Ndi yaulere.
kg_android_2: Tsitsani mapu ali pamwambapa. Foni yanu imawasunga mu Downloads.
kg_android_3: Tsegulani Kiwix, pitani ku laibulale yake ndipo onjezani fayilo yomwe mwatsitsa.
kg_ios_1: Ikani Kiwix kuchokera ku App Store. Ndi yaulere.
kg_ios_2: Tsitsani mapu ali pamwambapa. Safari imawasunga mu pulogalamu ya Files, pansi pa Downloads.
kg_ios_3: Tsegulani Kiwix, pitani ku laibulale yake ndipo tsegulani fayiloyo kuchokera mu Downloads.
kg_mac_1: Ikani Kiwix kuchokera ku Mac App Store, kenako tsegulani nayo fayilo yomwe mwatsitsa.
kg_pc_1: Tsegulani pulogalamu ya pa intaneti ya Kiwix mu msakatuli wanu ndipo sankhani fayilo yomwe mwatsitsa. Kiwix Desktop 2.5 imasonyeza mapu awa opanda kanthu; kukonza kwake kukupezeka m'mitundu ya tsiku ndi tsiku (nightly) yokha.
kg_offline: Mukatero, mapu amagwira ntchito popanda intaneti.
hero_apps: Amatseguka mu pulogalamu yaulere ya Kiwix:
tour_lead: Zonse za m'mavidiyo aafupi awa zimagwira ntchito kuchokera mu fayilo imodzi pa chipangizo. Anajambulidwa intaneti itadulidwa; mawu ofotokozera ndi madontho osonyeza pamene sikirini inadinidwa ndi zokhazo zomwe zinawonjezedwa pambuyo pake.
tour_photo_p: Jambulani chikwangwani cha msewu, cha sitolo kapena adilesi ya pa khadi la kiyi ya hotelo, ndipo mapu amasaka malo omwe alembedwa pamenepo. Mawuwo amawerengedwa pa chipangizo chanu, m'zilembo zomwe analembedwamo: apa Chiyukireniya, Chigiriki, Chiarabu, Chijapani, Chikoreya, Chitchaina ndi Chingerezi, mbali ndi mbali.
tour_photo_note: Pa mapu omwe ali ndi baji iyi.
tour_zoom_h: Kuchokera pa mzinda wonse mpaka pa nyumba imodzi
tour_zoom_p: Mapu a vector amakhalabe omveka bwino pa kukula kulikonse: yambani pa Kyiv yonse mpaka pa nyumba imodzi, kenako pendeketsani ndi kuzunguliza mapu.
tour_drive_p: Njira yodutsa Kyiv, yowerengedwa pa foni ndi kutsatiridwa kokhota ndi kokhota. Inajambulidwa ndi malo oyerekezera; gawo lapakati la ulendowu likusewera mofulumira kuwirikiza kakhumi.
tour_terrain_p: Mithunzi ya mapiri, nthaka ya 3D ndi zithunzi za setilaiti: mapiri a pamwamba pa Tehran.
tour_signs_h: Mtundu umodzi wa zilembo pa nthawi imodzi
tour_signs_p: Kusaka komweko m'mtundu uliwonse wa zilembo, pa mapu a mzinda umene chikwangwanicho chili.
tour_credits: Zithunzi za zikwangwani, chithunzi cha geti ndi zithunzi za setilaiti m'mavidiyo ndi m'zithunzi za sikirini izi ndi za anthu ena: onani eni ake ndi malayisensi.
gallery_lead: Masikirini enieni a mapu, pa kompyuta ndi pa foni. Sankhani chimodzi kuti muchione chachikulu, kenako pitirizani ku zina.
gal_building: Mpaka pa nyumba imodzi imodzi, mu 3D
gal_place: Khadi la malo lokhala ndi chithunzi ndi chidule cha Wikipedia
gal_find: Pezani makafe, masitolo ndi zina zapafupi
gal_turns: Malangizo a kokhota ndi kokhota, ngati mndandanda
gal_terrain_sat: Nthaka ya 3D ndi zithunzi za setilaiti
langs_lead: Mayina a malo, kusaka, malangizo a mayendedwe, nkhani za Wikipedia ndi mamenyu a mapu enieniwo, m'chilankhulo chimene mumawerenga. Kuphatikizapo zilembo zolembedwa kuchokera kumanja kupita kumanzere.
langs_step1_p: Chisankheni pa mndandanda uli pansipa, kapena pa menyu ya pamwamba pa tsamba lililonse.
langs_step2_p: Pa tsamba la chilankhulo chanu, batani lalikulu la mapu aliwonse limatsitsa mapu m'chilankhulocho, ngati fayilo imodzi ya .zim. Tsamba la Chingerezi ili limapereka mapu aliwonse monga anapangidwira: mayina a malo m'chilankhulo cha kumaloko, zolembedwa za pulogalamu ndi Wikipedia m'Chingerezi.
langs_step2_p_lang: Pa tsamba lino, batani lalikulu la mapu aliwonse ndi “Tsitsani m'Chichewa”: mapu okhala ndi mayina a malo, kusaka, Wikipedia ndi mamenyu m'Chichewa, ngati fayilo imodzi ya .zim. Ngati mapu sanakonzekebe m'Chichewa, khadi lake limanena choncho.
langs_step3_p: Mapu ambiri angapangidwenso m'zilankhulo zolankhulidwa kumeneko, monga Chikatalani cha Iberia kapena Chiwelesi cha Britain ndi Ireland. Tsamba la Mapu m'zilankhulo zina limandandalika chilankhulo chilichonse cha mapu aliwonse ndipo limasonkhanitsa fayilo mu msakatuli wanu.
langs_demo_note: Mapu omwewo a Kyiv m'Chiarabu, Chihebri, Chihindi, Chitayi, Chijapani ndi Chitchaina. Dzina lopanda matanthauzidwe limakhalabe monga limalembedwera kumaloko.
langs_grid_note: Nambalayi ikusonyeza kuti ndi mapu angati omwe ali okonzeka m'chilankhulocho lero.
filter_none: Palibe mapu ogwirizana ndi zimenezo. Yesani dziko, dera kapena mzinda.
credits_h: Zithunzi za m'mavidiyo aafupi ndi m'zithunzi za sikirini
credits_intro: Mavidiyo aafupi ndi zithunzi za sikirini zimasonyeza mapu monga alili. Zikwangwani za m'kusaka ndi chithunzi, chithunzi chimodzi cha malo odziwika ndi zithunzi za setilaiti ndi ntchito za anthu ena, zogwiritsidwa ntchito pansi pa malayisensi awa. Zithunzi za zikwangwani zinadulidwa.
